tools.name: sow_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a Postgres database schema, data patterns, and PII. Returns table info, row counts, detected PII columns, and edge cases.

tools.name: sow_detect
tools.description: Scan the current project to find PostgreSQL connection strings. Checks environment variables, .env files, Prisma schema, Drizzle config, Knex config, Docker Compose, and package.json dependencies. Returns all found connections with confidence levels. Use this before sow_connect to discover the connection string.

projectRoot.description: Path to the project root. Defaults to current working directory.

tools.name: sow_sandbox
tools.description: Flagship zero-config flow: detect the project's Postgres source, create a connector snapshot (or reuse an existing one), and spin up a local sandbox branch. Equivalent to the `sow sandbox` CLI command but safe for agents — never patches env files, never prompts. Returns the branch with its connection string. If multiple sources are detected, the first candidate is used; pass `connectionString` explicitly to override.

projectRoot.description: Path to the project root. Defaults to current working directory.

connectionString.description: Explicit Postgres source URL. Overrides auto-detection.

tools.name: sow_connect
tools.description: Connect to a production Postgres database, analyze it, sample representative data, sanitize PII, and save a local snapshot. This is required before creating branches. Only reads from production, never writes. Use full=true to copy ALL rows instead of sampling.

name.description: Name for this connector (default: database name)

maxRowsPerTable.description: Max rows to sample per table (default: 200, ignored if full=true)

full.description: Copy all rows instead of sampling (slower but no missing data)

tools.name: sow_connector_list
tools.description: List all saved database connectors (production DB snapshots). Each connector can be used to create branches.

tools.name: sow_branch_create
tools.description: Create an isolated test database branch with sanitized production-like data. Returns a connection string you can use immediately to read/write/test without affecting production. The branch runs as a local Docker container.

connector.description: Connector name (the production DB snapshot to branch from). Use sow_connector_list to see available connectors.

tools.name: sow_branch_list
tools.description: List all active database branches with their connection strings and status.

tools.name: sow_branch_delete
tools.description: Delete a database branch. This stops and removes the Docker container.

tools.name: sow_branch_diff
tools.description: Show what changed in a branch since it was created. Useful to verify what a coding agent modified.

tools.name: sow_branch_reset
tools.description: Reset a branch to its original state, discarding all changes. Like git reset --hard.

tools.name: sow_branch_info
tools.description: Get details about a database branch including its connection string, status, port, and connector.

tools.name: sow_branch_stop
tools.description: Stop a running database branch to save resources. The container is preserved and can be restarted later.

tools.name: sow_branch_start
tools.description: Start a previously stopped database branch. Returns the connection string.

tools.name: sow_branch_save
tools.description: Save the current state of a branch as a named checkpoint. You can load this checkpoint later if changes break things. Like git commit for databases.

tools.name: sow_branch_load
tools.description: Load a previously saved checkpoint into a branch, discarding all changes made after that checkpoint.

tools.name: sow_branch_exec
tools.description: Run SQL against a branch to set up specific test scenarios. Use this to create the exact data state needed for your test.

sql.description: SQL to execute (INSERT, UPDATE, CREATE TABLE, etc.)

tools.name: sow_connector_delete
tools.description: Delete a saved connector and its snapshot. Fails if any branches still reference this connector.

tools.name: sow_connector_refresh
tools.description: Re-create a connector's snapshot with fresh data from the original production database.

tools.name: sow_branch_env
tools.description: Get environment variables for a branch. Returns DATABASE_URL and (for Supabase branches) SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, etc. Use these to configure an app to run against the branch.

tools.name: sow_branch_users
tools.description: List test accounts available in a branch. All accounts share the same password. Use these to log into the app during testing.

tools.name: sow_branch_tables
tools.description: List all tables in a branch with row counts. Useful to understand what data is available before querying.

tools.name: sow_branch_sample
tools.description: Get sample rows from a table in a branch. Returns actual row data as JSON. Use to understand the schema and data shape.
